name: list_files
description: List a Floot project's virtual file tree with sizes, plus its dependencies, current version (pass the version to write tools as expected_version), and current project metadata — title, description, app icon (iconUrl), splash screen, mobile app id, SSR, iOS Info.plist overrides, share target (iOS + Android), native system bars. This is where to look up those settings; update_project_metadata changes them.
